conventions: Offsets are px relative to the dragon sprite origin (feet centre), y down. Angles are degrees, y-down (0=+x right, 90=down). Directional FX are drawn pointing +x: setOrigin(pivot), setRotation(angle). For left-facing use the per-frame mouthAngleDeg as-is and setFlipY(true) when cos(angle)<0 so tongues stay on top. Ground-aligned FX are never rotated; flip X for left.

breath_loop.note: loop 8f; rotate to mouthAngleDeg about pivot (mouth)
breath_loop.hitShape: cone along stream, length 330 px, half-width 9+0.21*dist (max ~78)

breath_start.note: stream extends from mouth; chain into breath_loop
breath_start.hitShape: cone along stream, length 70/150/230/300 px, half-width 9+0.21*dist

breath_end.note: stream detaches from mouth and burns out

breath_loop_molten.note: loop 8f; rotate to mouthAngleDeg about pivot (mouth)

breath_start_molten.note: stream extends from mouth; chain into breath_loop

breath_end_molten.note: stream detaches from mouth and burns out

mouth_ignite.note: spawn at mouth on breath spawn frame

ground_fire.note: where the stream meets the ground; loop while breath is on
ground_fire.howTo: anchor at the breath ground-hit point; see breathGroundClip (dGround=(groundDy-mouth.y)/sin(angle))

ground_fire_molten.howTo: anchor at the breath ground-hit point; see breathGroundClip (dGround=(groundDy-mouth.y)/sin(angle))

burn_patch.note: lingering ground fire after breath; fade/destroy after ~2 s
burn_patch.note2: drop one every ~150 ms along the ground hit path
burn_patch.howTo: anchor at the breath ground-hit point; see breathGroundClip (dGround=(groundDy-mouth.y)/sin(angle))

burn_patch_molten.howTo: anchor at the breath ground-hit point; see breathGroundClip (dGround=(groundDy-mouth.y)/sin(angle))

smoke_wisp.note: scatter along the stream end / after breath_end

nostril_smoke.note: idle: spawn at mouth every ~2 s; flip X for left

spark_burst.note: generic spark shower: breath ignite, impacts, crashes

hit_burst.note: on a landed hit: spawn at the hero

ember_loop.note: floating embers; tile several around the body

fireball.note: pivot = ball centre; rotate to travel angle; hitRadius 14

meteor.note: falls at 45deg down-right (flip X for down-left); hitRadius 16; spawn impact on landing
meteor.anchor: spawn 300px up-left of target (45deg), flipX for down-left

impact.note: fire explosion + rock debris + sparks; hitRadius 0,20,28,32,0,0,0,0

shockwave.note: ground fire ring: rx=36+28*f px, ry=0.26*rx; damage on ring band

fire_nova.note: t12: spawn f3 at dragon origin+(0,-130); invuln burst

death_fx.note: spawn on death f0 at origin+(0,-120); outlives the 12-frame body anim by 4 frames

aura_p3.note: phase 3 ambient: attach at dragon origin, loop; draw behind+in front (or front at alpha 1)

breathGroundClip.rule: Per frame, with mouth=(mx,my) px rel. dragon origin (y down, from attacks.json mouthData: x-320, y-400) and a=angleDeg: s=sin(a). If groundDy[facing] is null (up) or s<0.2 there is no ground hit: draw full stream. Else dGround=(groundDy-my)/s. If dGround<streamLen(frame) the stream is clipped: visibleLen=dGround, hit point=(mx+cos(a)*dGround, groundDy) in dragon space.
breathGroundClip.runtimeClip: Preferred: a rectangle GeometryMask covering everything above worldGroundY = dragon.y + groundDy*scale (pixels below the ground line hidden; this is exactly what the previews bake). Cheaper alternative: setCrop(0,0,pivotPx.x+dGround+6,h) on the unrotated stream frame (crop is in texture space before rotation, so it cuts across the stream at dGround; the lower cone edge can poke <=~half-width*cos(a) px past the ground, hidden by the splash).
breathGroundClip.splashAtHit: While clipped: ground_fire(_molten) at the hit point every frame (flipX when facing left), burn_patch(_molten) dropped every ~150 ms at hit point +-10 px x, +4 px y (drawn under the body), smoke_wisp x2 at the last hit point when breath_end starts. Hit area: ground_fire hitRadius around the hit point; the cone hit test should also be limited to dist<=dGround.

up.note: Aiming up (away from camera) the breath leaves the back/top of the head: draw breath_*, mouth_ignite, spark_burst and fireballs at a depth BELOW the dragon body sprite (e.g. depth=dragon.depth-1). No ground hit (groundDy null). Use mouthData up angles as given (around -90).

down.note: front view: ground line is the front edge of the shadow, 36 px below origin

left.note: ground-aligned FX flipX; directional FX rotate by angleDeg and flipY when cos<0
